messages:
Noah Kim: Heads up 026-05-07: Several customers reported an unexpected jump in embedding charges tied to last week's pricing experiment. Can billing confirm if SKU mapping changed?
Ava Patel: Which customers?
Noah Kim: Beta customers on the "embeds-lowlatency" feature flag: payloads look identical but unit price in ledger is 10x lower for some rows and 10x higher for others.
Ravi Shah: I pulled the billing_events for the experiment window (2026-05-01 to 2026-05-03). We released an A/B rollout that swapped embed.sku from "embeddings.standard.v1" to "embeddings.exp.v1" in the ingest metadata, but our pricing join uses a cached price table keyed by sku + region. Cache invalidation was partial during rollout.
Leila Ortiz: Sample lines?
Ravi Shah: sample: ```json
{"ts":"2026-05-01T12:03:02Z","org":"vertexai","req_id":"e_33f","sku":"embeddings.exp.v1","embed_units":120,"price_per_unit_cents":0}
{"ts":"2026-05-01T12:03:04Z","org":"vertexai","req_id":"e_33f-retry","sku":"embeddings.exp.v1","embed_units":120,"price_per_unit_cents":5}```
Ravi Shah: The price_per_unit_cents field shows 0 for some rows and 5 for others depending on whether the pricing cache warmed. That explains under/over billing.
Ava Patel: Oof. Any estimate of delta across the impacted orgs?
Ravi Shah: Quick aggregate from billing_mirror: billed_if_corrected=1,150,000 embed_units priced at correct rate; currently billed equivalent is 1,070,000 priced correctly + 80,000 priced at 0 (underbilled) and 12,000 priced at 5x (overbilled). Net delta in dollars across all beta orgs ~= -$32.40 (we underbilled overall).
Noah Kim: Customers are asking for CSVs showing per-event price and the corrected totals. Finance: can we apply backfill to rewrite price_per_unit for affected events and then issue adjustments?
Ava Patel: Before approving, we need: (1) scope list of affected orgs (2) dry-run CSV with original vs corrected price columns + checksum (3) risk note about retroactive pricing changes during experiments.
Leila Ortiz: I'll generate the scope list and run dry-run; include cache key, sku, region, and timestamps so we can audit. ETA 3 hours.
billing-bot: Precheck: pricing backfill requires (a) experiment flag audit, (b) dry-run CSV + md5, (c) finance approval.
Ravi Shah: Also note: some events were ingested with price_per_unit_cents=0 due to a race where pricing service returned 404 and we defaulted to 0 for experiment telemetry. Fix planned: fallback to last-known price, not 0. ENG ticket ENG-5288 opened.
Ava Patel: Good. If dry-run confirms net underbilling, we should correct ledger so invoices are accurate. For any customers who already paid, we'll issue a pro-rated credit or debit depending on sign. Approve dry-run scope generation.
Noah Kim: Customer comms: short note describing that a pricing cache inconsistency during an experiment led to inconsistent unit prices for a subset of embedding events; we will run a controlled backfill to correct pricing fields and provide per-event CSV + checksum.
Leila Ortiz: Dry-run done. Uploaded CSV s3://fin-audit/dryruns/1806000000-pricing-experiment.csv md5=4d2f6b8a9c7e5f1b2a3c4d5e6f7a8b9c. Rows=1,982. Corrections: 80,120 embed_units moved from price=0 to price=1 cent/unit, 12,000 units were overcharged at 5c -> corrected to 1c. Net amount delta = -$32.40.
Ava Patel: Approve ledger correction and backfill commit with audit markers. Finance will treat net underbilling as a deferred revenue discrepancy; accounting will schedule an adjustment in the next close. For customers that already paid and request immediate invoice updates, we'll issue CSV and an explanatory memo.
Ravi Shah: Scheduling controlled commit: backfill will be idempotent and reference experiment_run_id. Will include per-event before/after and commit md5.
billing-bot: Backfill gated: awaiting finance sign-off and experiment owner confirmation.
Noah Kim: Confirmed with product owners that experiment_run_id=exp-2026-05-01-A is the one to reference. Proceed when ENG posts commit CSV and checksum.
Ava Patel: Thanks team. Please add a short postmortem summarizing cache invalidation gap and the fallback-to-zero bug. We'll track as FIN-2026-058.
Leila Ortiz: Will upload commit CSV and note once done. Thanks.
